src/lib/agent-knowledge.ts     -> imports this file directly, renders the LLM prompt
Why this lives under backend/ and not at the repo root:
docker-compose.yml sets the backend build context to ./backend, and Render's
root directory is 'backend'. A root-level knowledge/ would not exist inside the
backend image. The frontend builds from the repo root (no .vercelignore), so it
can reach down into backend/. This directory is the intersection of all three
build contexts. Moving it up breaks production silently.
Rule: every claim here must be demonstrable. See CLAUDE.md section 0.

projects.status: v1.1.0; public recorded offline demo; synthetic data
projects.summary: Offline procurement simulator checking approval, budget and retry rules, including a scripted false-success claim rejected by an independent evaluator. Deterministic and scripted controllers make zero model calls; an opt-in live controller was evaluated separately. Live-evaluated with Claude Haiku 4.5: 10/10 trials matched expected outcomes—5 authorized purchases and 5 refusals in a supplier-injection scenario whose reviewer declines every proposal. Total cost: $0.12. Small-sample evidence of workflow compliance; live bypass enforcement was not exercised, and reliability remains uncertain. No live-agent safety or production reliability claim.

projects.name: Factory Line
projects.status: in development; private repository, source available on request
projects.summary: An agentic software factory for Claude Code. Agents do the work (spec-writer, builder, 4 parallel reviewers, approver); a deterministic router, board.py, applies the merge or rework rule from a typed verdict, not a model: its POLICY SEAM merges only when decision is merge, risk is low and tests_passed is literally true. First app: neon-agent, a document-assistant backend on Neon (Postgres, Auth, Functions, Storage). Its security design was chosen by tests on a real database branch: Option A failed for a recorded reason (Neon refuses a non-owner role access to its auth schema, and the signing key cannot pass the connection pooler), so Option B shipped. Per-user isolation is enforced by Postgres itself through forced row-level security; every job branch gets its own credentials and the old ones were proven rejected. As of 14 October 2026 a health API and a documents API are deployed to a development branch, checked with real sign-in tokens. The agent line itself is written but not yet run end-to-end. Next, planned and nothing built yet: AI chat and document ingestion.
metrics: Health and documents APIs deployed to a development branch, 14 October 2026

projects.name: Weekly Certification Loop
projects.summary: A budgeted agent loop that finds, verifies and publishes free AI certifications every week. Windows Task Scheduler fires a heartbeat every 7 days; a headless Claude Code agent searches 10 providers within a hard budget (at most 10 searches, 12 fetches and $2.50 per run); certloop.py verifies the findings deterministically (every provider searched, at least 5 opportunities, required fields, official https links, no duplicates); a maker-checker pass enforces the README's structure, tone and sentence length; each week is appended to progress.md with finds tagged new or returning, then committed and pushed. Providers with no official programme are recorded as such. The repository has no automated test suite.

Reporter does not explicitly render specialist errors; inspect run errors and traces alongside report text.
